{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/util.cpp and sanitizes error responses across RPC methods including getdescriptorinfo and scantxoutset to avoid exposing sensitive key material.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents accidental leakage of private keys and xprvs in RPC error messages. The change directly addresses the exposure of sensitive data via RPC error returns, which otherwise carries secret key material 'into places the request may not go: an application's log, an error reporter, a screenshot shared for help.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "A single line edit in src/util/bip32.cpp (+1/-1) merely follows the descriptor error formatting changes and does not alter shared utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change in bip32.cpp is a minor follow-on edit to support descriptor error sanitization rather than an improvement to shared utility libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp to stop echoing raw private key strings during wallet imports and transaction funding.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Stops wallet error messages from echoing raw WIF strings and extended private keys into logs and exception reports. As noted in the description, failing descriptor parsing or derivation previously leaked 'sensitive private key material into application logs, exception reporting systems, or support screenshots', creating a potential risk to fund safety."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
